name: rm-safety
description: Intercepts risky rm commands with pre-execution safety checks, impact assessment, and user confirmation | 拦截高危 rm 命令，执行前安全检查，影响评估，用户确认
author: Caesar (@CaesarYP)
examples: rm file.txt → Triggers safety confirmation | 触发安全确认
rm -rf ./folder → Shows file/dir count before execution | 显示文件/目录数
trash file.txt → No confirmation needed (safe delete) | 无需确认（安全删除）
features: Pre-execution safety confirmation | 执行前安全确认
Impact assessment (file/dir count) | 影响评估（文件/目录统计）
Safer alternatives (trash, backup, temp move) | 安全替代方案
Path injection prevention (quoting, -- separator) | 路径注入防护
Bilingual EN/ZH documentation | 中英双语文档
Security hardened (OpenClaw scan: Benign) | 安全加固（OpenClaw 扫描：Benign）
